response.sql:
WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
rate_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS cross_media_type_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT m.avg_unit_price, m.byte_rate, b.cross_media_type_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates AS m
  CROSS JOIN rate_baseline AS b
  WHERE m.byte_rate > b.cross_media_type_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_of_media_type_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate,
  AVG(byte_rate - cross_media_type_avg_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Media types with no tracks having a non-NULL Bytes value are excluded from the cross-media-type average because their byte rate is undefined.
